messages:
rafael: Skylark.dev reporting a streaming hang. generator from Python SDK stops yielding after a partial token. Repro attached, they say it started after a deploy yesterday. SDK v0.9.2, httpx 0.25.0, python 3.10. Trace: trc_01Gabc999, req: req_2026_7788.

maya: can you paste a minimal repro + the raw bytes or tcp dump? need request ids and last-server-send.

rafael: repro below. note this uses a message with multibyte characters which seems to trigger it. server keeps sending SSE frames but our generator yields nothing after a split.

```python
# repro: python-sdk stream generator
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key="REDACTED")
gen = client.chat.stream(model="redwood-alpha", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "say hi 你好"}])
for part in gen:
    print('CHUNK:', part)
```

raw SSE bytes (snip):

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
content-type: text/event-stream

id: 1
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"Hel"}}

id: 2
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"lo \""}}

# next chunk splits inside utf8 sequence for '你' (E4 BD A0)
id: 3
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"\xe4\xbd"}}

id: 4
event: message
data: {"role":"assistant","delta":{"content":"\xa0, world"}}

# after id:3 the client yields nothing, socket stays open and keepalive pings continue

maya: interesting. socket not closed, so likely parser buffering bug on client side. did they try raw iter_lines on requests/httpx directly?

rafael: yes — raw iter_bytes on requests consumed and stitched ok. the SDK generator remains stuck.

sam: that matches a known edge-case — in 0.9.2 our SSE state machine assumed data lines would arrive aligned to UTF-8 boundaries and only flushed on a full event. httpx 0.25 changed chunk boundaries semantics; when a multibyte utf8 char splits across chunks, our decoder could block waiting for CRLF or get confused and not emit the event. we hardened this in 0.9.4 to handle partial utf-8 + partial JSON inside SSE data.

elaine: do we know if this is strictly httpx 0.25+ dependent?

rafael: customer confirmed httpx 0.25.0. environment pinned by other deps so they can't upgrade straight away.

sam: actionable items: 1) ask them to try SDK v0.9.4 and report back; 2) provide a short in-place workaround for 0.9.2 they can drop in; 3) eng-runtime to prepare a backport/hotfix if they can't upgrade.

maya: can you provide the workaround snippet we can send? also tag eng for a hotfix.

sam: workaround (low-level stitcher) — bypass SDK SSE parser and stitch chunks into events, tolerant to multibyte splits:

```python
# workaround: low-level streaming stitcher for pinned SDKs
resp = client._http.stream("GET", "/v1/chat/stream", params={...}, headers={...})
buf = bytearray()
for chunk in resp.iter_bytes():
    if not chunk:
        continue
    buf.extend(chunk)
    # find double-newline separators for SSE events
    while b"\n\n" in buf:
        idx = buf.index(b"\n\n")
        event = bytes(buf[:idx])
        del buf[:idx+2]
        # rudimentary parse: pull data: lines, join multiple data: entries
        lines = [l.strip() for l in event.split(b"\n") if l.strip().startswith(b"data:")]
        if not lines:
            continue
        payload = b"\n".join([l.split(b"data:",1)[1].lstrip() for l in lines])
        try:
            yield payload.decode('utf-8')
        except UnicodeDecodeError:
            # if decode fails, replace errors to avoid blocking
            yield payload.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
```

sam: this avoids relying on the SDK's SSE state machine. it's not pretty but safe until they can upgrade.

incident-bot: alert: P1 customer Skylark.dev — streaming hang. SLA window: 5h 40m.

rafael: sent workaround and asked them to test v0.9.4 in staging. also collected tcp dump and trace id.

maya: escalated to eng-runtime @sam. please prepare hotfix branch and unit tests covering chunk-split across multibyte utf8 and partial JSON data.

sam: hotfix branch created: hotfix/sse-split-utf8-0.9.5. reproduction test added. ETA for candidate build: ~3h. will also add explicit compatibility note for httpx >=0.25 in release notes.

elaine: add an integration test that simulates keepalive pings + long idle to ensure generator doesn't deadlock on empty frames.

rafael: customer confirmed v0.9.4 fixed the hang in staging today. they're planning prod roll tomorrow. asked them to notify once prod is stable so we can close the P1.

maya: great. patch + docs todo: short note in streaming docs about older SDKs and httpx 0.25 chunking change, and include the workaround snippet.

alex: communicate to support mailing list to look for pinned SDK 0.9.2 + httpx 0.25 combos.

rafael: will follow up after prod rollout. thanks all :thumbsup:
